finding.detail: A broad `except KeyError: pass` covers both grp.getgrnam and the subsequent prior receipt lookups. If the checker group exists but its R3 receipt is absent, malformed, or lacks `created_group_gid`, the KeyError is swallowed. `existing_group` remains set, so groupadd is skipped and the script proceeds with the unverified group's GID.
finding.recommendation: Catch KeyError only around grp.getgrnam. If the group exists, parse the R3 receipt and require all ownership/recovery/GID/member predicates; any missing or malformed receipt field must abort before writes.

secondary_note: Readiness is gated on both sockets but the existing 60 x 0.2s loop gives a 12-second deadline. Confirm this fits the observed gateway startup time or lengthen the bounded loop within the 300-second runner limit.
